rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday noun for a habitual tendency to be lazy.

example.english: His indolence is impossible to change; whatever we ask him to do, he puts it off until the last minute.
example.traditional: 佢嘅懶性真係改唔到，叫佢做乜都拖到最後一刻。
